# nb-studio issue

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-cli-reference.mjs from the API document. Do not edit: change the route’s describeRoute() or x-cli, then run `node scripts/gen-cli-reference.mjs`. -->

## issue activity list

List an issue’s activities

Older activities, cursor-paged from the issue’s `activitiesNextCursor`. `issueId` is an id or an identifier such as `PM-12`.

```bash
nb-studio issue activity list <issue>
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `issue`  |             |

| Flag           | Type    | Description  |
| -------------- | ------- | ------------ |
| `--limit`      | integer | (default 20) |
| `--page-token` | string  |              |

**Output:** A list (table columns: `createdAt`, `actorName`, `action`, `via`); with `--json`, `result.data` is the array and `result.meta` the paging.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key); needs the action `pm.issues/view`.

**Request:** `GET /api/projects/issues/{issueId}/activities` (`projectsListIssueActivities`)

## issue attachment add

Attach a file to an issue

Needs `upload` on `pm.attachments` and `edit` on the issue. One file as the `file` field of a multipart body, at most 20971520 bytes.

```bash
nb-studio issue attachment add <issue> --file <path>
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `issue`  |             |

| Flag     | Type | Description |
| -------- | ---- | ----------- |
| `--file` | path | (required)  |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key); needs the action `pm.attachments/upload`.

**Request:** `POST /api/projects/issues/{issueId}/attachments` (`projectsUploadIssueAttachment`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio issue attachment add PM-12 --file design.png
```

## issue attachment download

Download a file

The file’s bytes. A safe raster image is served inline unless `download=true`; anything else, SVG and HTML included, as a download. Always with `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, `Content-Security-Policy: sandbox` and `Cache-Control: private, no-store`.

```bash
nb-studio issue attachment download <file>
```

| Argument | Description                                      |
| -------- | ------------------------------------------------ |
| `file`   | The file id; `issue attachment list` gives them. |

| Flag    | Type | Description                                           |
| ------- | ---- | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| `--out` | path | Where to save the file, or a directory to save it in. |

**Output:** A file, saved in the current directory under its own name or where `--out` says; with `--json`, `result.data` says where it went.

**Who:** People, and agents in a run; needs the action `pm.issues/view`.

**Request:** `GET /api/projects/attachments/{attachmentId}/content` (`projectsDownloadAttachment`)

List an issue’s files

The issue’s own files, oldest first; with `comments=true`, then the files of its comments that are not deleted (each with its `commentId`). `issueId` is an id or an identifier.

```bash
nb-studio issue attachment list <issue>
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `issue`  |             |

| Flag         | Type    | Description              |
| ------------ | ------- | ------------------------ |
| `--comments` | boolean | Its comments’ files too. |

**Output:** A list (table columns: `id`, `filename`, `size`, `mimeType`, `commentId`); with `--json`, `result.data` is the array and `result.meta` the paging.

**Who:** People, and agents in a run; needs the action `pm.issues/view`.

**Request:** `GET /api/projects/issues/{issueId}/attachments` (`projectsListIssueAttachments`)

## issue checklist mark

Check or uncheck a checklist item

Needs `edit` on the issue. Answers the checklist after the change.

```bash
nb-studio issue checklist mark <issue> <status> <item> --checked
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `issue`  |             |
| `status` |             |
| `item`   |             |

| Flag        | Type    | Description                                                      |
| ----------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--checked` | boolean | `--checked` ticks the item, `--no-checked` clears it. (required) |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key); needs the action `pm.issues/edit`.

**Request:** `PATCH /api/projects/issues/{issueId}/checklists/{statusKey}/items/{itemKey}` (`projectsUpdateChecklistItem`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio issue checklist mark PM-12 in_review tests-pass --checked
nb-studio issue checklist mark PM-12 in_review tests-pass --no-checked
```

## issue comment add

Comment on an issue

Needs `comment` on the issue, and `upload` on `pm.attachments` to send `attachmentIds` (the caller’s uploads attached to nothing). Markdown, with mentions as `[@Name](mention://<kind>/<id>)`; a comment starting with `/note` starts no work.

```bash
nb-studio issue comment add <issue> --content <string>
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `issue`  |             |

| Flag         | Type   | Description                                                                                                                                 |
| ------------ | ------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--content`  | string | The comment, in Markdown. Write anything longer than a line to a file and pass it with --content-file. (required; or --content-file <path>) |
| `--reply-to` | string | The id of the comment this answers.                                                                                                         |
| `--attach`   | path   | A file to attach (repeatable); attaching needs `upload` on `pm.attachments`. (uploaded first, repeatable)                                   |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People, and agents in a run; needs the action `pm.issues/comment`.

**Request:** `POST /api/projects/issues/{issueId}/comments` (`projectsCreateIssueComment`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio issue comment add PM-12 --content-file note.md --attach screenshot.png
```

A page of threads, the newest page first and each page oldest first; a thread is a root and all its replies. `issueId` is an id or an identifier.

```bash

```

| -------- | ----------- |
| `issue`  |             |

| Flag           | Type    | Description  |
| -------------- | ------- | ------------ |
| `--limit`      | integer | (default 20) |
| `--page-token` | string  |              |

**Output:** A list (table columns: `root.id`, `root.authorName`, `root.createdAt`, `root.content`, `replies.length`); with `--json`, `result.data` is the array and `result.meta` the paging.

**Who:** People, and agents in a run; needs the action `pm.issues/view`.

**Request:** `GET /api/projects/issues/{issueId}/comments` (`projectsListIssueComments`)

## issue create

Create an issue

Needs `create` on `pm.issues` for the issue’s project. The issue starts in `todo` unless `statusKey` names another status it may start in; the caller owns it unless `ownerUserId` says otherwise.

```bash
nb-studio issue create
```

| Flag              | Type      | Description                                                                                                                |
| ----------------- | --------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--title`         | string    |                                                                                                                            |
| `--description`   | string    | (or --description-file <path>)                                                                                             |
| `--status`        | string    | The status it starts in: analysis (design first), todo (straight to development, the default) or backlog (nothing starts). |
| `--priority`      | urgent \\ | high \\                                                                                                                    | medium \\ | low \\ | none |     |
| `--owner`         | string    |                                                                                                                            |
| `--executor`      | json      |                                                                                                                            |
| `--parent`        | string    |                                                                                                                            |
| `--stage`         | integer   |                                                                                                                            |
| `--project`       | string    |                                                                                                                            |
| `--start-date`    | string    |                                                                                                                            |
| `--due-date`      | string    |                                                                                                                            |
| `--label`         | string[]  | (repeatable)                                                                                                               |
| `--start`         | boolean   |                                                                                                                            |
| `--blocked-by`    | string[]  | (repeatable)                                                                                                               |
| `--project-setup` | boolean   |                                                                                                                            |
| `--file`          | path      | The request body as a JSON object; the flags override its fields.                                                          |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People, and agents in a run; needs the action `pm.issues/create`.

**Request:** `POST /api/projects/issues` (`projectsCreateIssue`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio issue create --file issue.json --status todo
```

## issue delete

Delete an issue

Needs `delete` on `pm.issues`. The issue moves to the deleted list and can be restored. `issueId` is an id or an identifier such as `PM-12`.

```bash
nb-studio issue delete <issue>
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `issue`  |             |

| Flag    | Type    | Description                                                                           |
| ------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--yes` | boolean | Go ahead without asking “Delete this issue? It can be restored with `issue restore`.” |

**Output:** Nothing; prints `Done.`.

**Who:** People, and agents in a run; needs the action `pm.issues/delete`.

**Request:** `DELETE /api/projects/issues/{issueId}` (`projectsDeleteIssue`)

## issue dependency add

Add a dependency to an issue

Needs `edit` on the issue. `issueId` and `dependsOnIssueId` are ids or identifiers. `blockedBy` (the default) holds the issue until the other is finished; `relatedTo` only links them.

```bash
nb-studio issue dependency add <issue> <dependsOn>
```

| Argument    | Description                                  |
| ----------- | -------------------------------------------- |
| `issue`     |                                              |
| `dependsOn` | The issue it waits for, by identifier or id. |

| Flag     | Type         | Description |
| -------- | ------------ | ----------- |
| `--type` | blockedBy \\ | relatedTo   |     |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People, and agents in a run; needs the action `pm.issues/edit`.

**Request:** `POST /api/projects/issues/{issueId}/dependencies` (`projectsAddIssueDependency`)

## issue dependency remove

Remove a dependency by the other issue

Needs `edit` on the issue. `issueId` and `dependsOnIssueId` are ids or identifiers. Removes the link of `type` (`blockedBy` by default) to `dependsOnIssueId`.

```bash
nb-studio issue dependency remove <issue> <dependsOn>
```

| Argument    | Description                                  |
| ----------- | -------------------------------------------- |
| `issue`     |                                              |
| `dependsOn` | The issue it waits for, by identifier or id. |

| Flag     | Type         | Description |
| -------- | ------------ | ----------- |
| `--type` | blockedBy \\ | relatedTo   |     |

**Output:** Nothing; prints `Done.`.

**Who:** People, and agents in a run; needs the action `pm.issues/edit`.

**Request:** `POST /api/projects/issues/{issueId}/removeDependency` (`projectsRemoveIssueDependency`)

## issue design-proposal

Submit a design proposal for an issue

Only the agent of a run on the issue, in the design-first flow: the issue defaults to the run’s. Submitting moves an issue in Analysis to Proposal review, which asks its owner; a new proposal replaces the earlier one. `meta.message` words the outcome.

```bash
nb-studio issue design-proposal [<issue>] --content <string>
```

| Argument | Description                                                                                 |
| -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `issue`  | The issue, by identifier (PM-12) or id; the issue of the calling run by default. (optional) |

| Flag        | Type   | Description                                                                                                         |
| ----------- | ------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--content` | string | The proposal, in Markdown; write it to a file and pass it with --content-file. (required; or --content-file <path>) |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** Only agents in a run; needs the action `pm.issues/comment`.

**Request:** `POST /api/designProposals` (`designProposalsSubmit`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio issue design-proposal --content-file proposal.md
```

Principals of kinds other plugins registered, such as agents, that the caller may make an issue’s executor.

```bash

```

**Output:** A list (table columns: `type`, `id`, `name`, `online`, `busy`); with `--json`, `result.data` is the array and `result.meta` the paging.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `GET /api/projects/executors` (`projectsListExecutors`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio issue update PM-12 --executor type=agent --executor id=<id>
```

Needs `delete` on `pm.issues`. `issueId` is an id or an identifier such as `PM-12`.

```bash
nb-studio issue restore <issue>
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `issue`  |             |

## issue runs

List an issue's agent runs

Newest first: who ran, why, how it ended and its summary. Needs `pm.issues/view` on an issue the caller sees; lists the runs the caller started or owns, or every run with `agents.agents` read. An agent’s run reads for the person who woke it. `meta.message` says when there are none.

```bash
nb-studio issue runs [<issue>]
```

| Argument | Description                                                                                        |
| -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `issue`  | The issue, by identifier (PM-12) or id; an agent's run on an issue defaults to its own. (optional) |

| Flag           | Type    | Description                                |
| -------------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| `--limit`      | integer | At most this many runs (100). (default 20) |
| `--page-token` | string  |                                            |

**Output:** A list (table columns: `id`, `agent`, `status`, `trigger`, `createdAt`, `summary`); with `--json`, `result.data` is the array and `result.meta` the paging.

**Who:** People, and agents in a run; needs the action `pm.issues/view`.

**Request:** `GET /api/issueRuns` (`issueRunsList`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio issue runs PM-12
nb-studio issue runs PM-12 --limit 5
```

## issue search

List issues

The issues the caller sees, cursor-paged. `deleted=true` lists deleted issues instead, for those who may delete issues; `parentIssueId=none` lists top-level issues only.

```bash
nb-studio issue search
```

| Flag           | Type    | Description                                                             |
| -------------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--status`     | string  |                                                                         |
| `--project`    | string  |                                                                         |
| `--owner`      | string  |                                                                         |
| `--executor`   | string  |                                                                         |
| `--label`      | string  |                                                                         |
| `--parent`     | string  | A parent issue, by identifier (PM-12) or id; none for top-level issues. |
| `--q`          | string  |                                                                         |
| `--deleted`    | boolean |                                                                         |
| `--order-by`   | string  |                                                                         |
| `--limit`      | integer | (default 20)                                                            |
| `--page-token` | string  |                                                                         |

**Output:** A list (table columns: `identifier`, `title`, `statusKey`, `owner.name`, `executorName`); with `--json`, `result.data` is the array and `result.meta` the paging.

**Who:** People, and agents in a run; needs the action `pm.issues/view`.

**Request:** `GET /api/projects/issues` (`projectsListIssues`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio issue search --q login --status todo
nb-studio issue search --parent PM-12
```

## issue update

Update an issue

Needs `edit` on the issue; closing it and changing its owner need `close` and `change-owner`. `issueId` is an id or an identifier such as `PM-12`.

```bash
nb-studio issue update <issue>
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `issue`  |             |

| Flag            | Type      | Description                                                         |
| --------------- | --------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--title`       | string    |                                                                     |
| `--description` | string    | (or --description-file <path>)                                      |
| `--status`      | string    | Move it to this status, through its workflow's rules and approvals. |
| `--priority`    | urgent \\ | high \\                                                             | medium \\ | low \\ | none |     |
| `--owner`       | string    |                                                                     |
| `--executor`    | json      |                                                                     |
| `--parent`      | string    |                                                                     |
| `--stage`       | integer   |                                                                     |
| `--project`     | string    |                                                                     |
| `--start-date`  | string    |                                                                     |
| `--due-date`    | string    |                                                                     |
| `--label`       | string[]  | (repeatable)                                                        |
| `--start`       | boolean   |                                                                     |
| `--file`        | path      | The request body as a JSON object; the flags override its fields.   |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People, and agents in a run; needs the action `pm.issues/edit`.

**Request:** `PATCH /api/projects/issues/{issueId}` (`projectsUpdateIssue`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio issue update PM-12 --status in_review
nb-studio issue update PM-12 --file change.json
```
